en.old: The marketplace sample is the original September 28, 2026 Amazon.com search of eight returned records and three distinct-brand details. Duplicate bullets were deduplicated for analysis only; original wrappers are retained. A later same-day inspection of the exact-ASIN initial galleries supplies the label values above. Sprout’s nutrition and ingredient panels are artwork; Anthony’s and Micro’s include back-pouch images. Gallery identity is tied to the listing, not to a purchased physical sample. Supplier limits remain supplier assertions; no purchase, batch COA, independent certification audit or finished-product trial was performed. Scientific results refer to the specified experimental materials, not the three retail products. Prices, review counts, market share and nutrition rankings are deliberately outside this analysis.
en.new: The sample covers eight Amazon.com search records and three distinct-brand detail pages on September 28, 2026, plus their exact-ASIN initial galleries. Sprout’s nutrition and ingredient panels are artwork; Anthony’s and Micro’s include back-pouch images. These are seller displays, not purchased samples or batch analyses. Supplier specifications and scientific results describe their respective materials, not verified performance of the three retail powders. This comparison does not rank prices, sales, certification or nutritional quality.

zh.old: 本文使用2026年9月28日原始 Amazon.com 搜索返回的八条记录，以及三个不同品牌的商品详情。分析时去除了重复要点，原始采集包装文件完整保留。同日后续查看了对应ASIN的初始商品图库，补充了上文标签数据。Sprout 的营养和配料信息来自标签设计图，Anthony’s 与 Micro 则有背袋照片；图库与商品页的对应关系不等于已核验购买实物。供应商规格仍属供应商声明；没有进行购买、批次COA核验、独立认证审核或成品试验。论文数据只对应各自的实验材料，不对应这三款零售商品。本文不作价格、评价数量、市场份额或营养高低排名。
